JOB_DESC:
Company Overview
We are a technology-focused organization working in SaaS, Product Development, FinTech, and EdTech industries, seeking talented developers to join our engineering team.
Role Overview
We are seeking a results-driven and detail-oriented Full Stack Web Developer with proven experience in architecting, building, deploying, and maintaining high-performance web applications. The ideal candidate will demonstrate deep expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks, RESTful APIs, cloud-native services, and scalable system design.
Key Responsibilities
Design and implement full stack solutions using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB
Lead migration from Angular to React using modular design principles
Develop and maintain high-performance REST APIs and backend services
Architect microfrontend-based systems and build proxy applications
Integrate and optimize third-party services like Razorpay
Implement CMS functionalities including dynamic dashboards and job posting systems
Establish CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodeCatalyst
Utilize AWS services for email management, monitoring, and storage
Improve SEO and web accessibility through optimization techniques
Lead code reviews and mentor junior developers
Requirements
2-4 years of full stack development experience
Expertise in React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB
Experience with AWS services and cloud-native development
Knowledge of authentication and security protocols
Proficiency in testing frameworks and version control
Strong problem-solving skills and passion for clean code
Mandatory Requirements
2-4 years of experience in full stack development
Proven experience with React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
Knowledge of AWS services (Cognito, SES, CloudFront, CloudWatch)
Experience with REST APIs and authentication workflows
Proficiency in Git version control and testing frameworks
Preferred Requirements
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification
Experience with microfrontend architecture
Knowledge of FIX API and algorithmic trading environments
Experience building LLM-based applications
SEO optimization and accessibility standards knowledge
Working knowledge of Angular framework
Additional Information
Employment Type: Full-time | Experience Level: 2-4 years | Location: Remote/Bangalore/Delhi NCR | Industry: SaaS/Product Development/Technology/FinTech/EdTech
